prompts.text: Does your neighbourhood have a nickname that visitors wouldn't find on a map?
Tell me about learning why people call a particular junction or street by an unexpected name.
A street named after a historical person or a place named after something that used to stand there?
Local nicknames for places sometimes last longer than their official names.
You're giving directions using only names longtime residents use. Which stop might confuse a newcomer?
What's a place name people in your area pronounce differently from how it's written?
The stories behind ordinary street names deserve a place in local history.
Describe someone correcting your name for a place and explaining the version they grew up with.
A friend asks why an old neighbourhood name still appears in conversation. Who would you ask for the story?
Which local place has changed so much its old name now sounds surprising?
